stages.headline: What does the parallel axiom say?

choices: Only one line passes through two points
Only one parallel passes through a point off a line
optionsQuiz.feedbackIncorrect: 🤔 Not quite. The correct answer is {correctText}. 1. Only one parallel through an outside point.
